what: Vallée writes you a song, then lets you perform it. One press writes an intro, verses, choruses, a bridge and an outro in one of twelve styles; then the keys become the song's parts, each landing on the next bar. Moog, Oberheim and Juno filters, original drum kits. Built on Skiff by illuminus5.
author: tammygucci
